history.body: Hi, saw the Pearl Residences ad. We’re renting now and starting to look at our first place. What’s the layout like?

Pearl Residences’ Phase 1 homes are 900 sq ft, with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The living, dining and kitchen areas are open-plan, with an entrance foyer for a bit of privacy and no long internal corridor. For a first place, the third bedroom gives you flexibility for a study, guests or future needs. Would you mainly use it as a bedroom or a study?
Probably a study for now, then maybe a bedroom later. Are the bedrooms all a decent size?

That makes sense for a first home—the third room could work as a study now and a bedroom later. I don’t have verified dimensions for each bedroom, so I don’t want to guess whether they’ll feel spacious. I’ll check the room-by-room measurements for you.
